items.title: Joe Lyde Interview, 1959-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Cutshaw. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right. I know, I could tell you that...

ctx.x: Well, Wild Bill, Pee Wee Russell, Cuddy.

That's right. I know, I could tell you that, I forget, Wettling was on drums. No, was he, no, wait a minute, no, a younger chap. I heard him another time, he was on drums. No, it was a younger chap on drums. A colored bass player, fat fellow with a white goatee, and I think Schroeder on piano. I think that was it, and Condon didn't play it all the whole evening. Then I got the bus down here.
